regions.merged_text: Many thanks for kind favor of Febr. 6th -- duly Rec'd and noted. Glad to know that things seem brightening up. Thanks be to God for all His mercies Am herewith inclosing a few "jubilee cards." Thanks be to God for such privileges as have been mine these fifty years.
